content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Donald Trump For President's PostDonald Trump For President3d · Shared with PublicJustin Bieber's Coachella Cash Grab Delivers BigJustin Bieber turned his headlining slot at Coachella 2026 into a major money machine. The pop star's performance racked up over $70 million in value across Facebook, Instagram, X, and TikTok. On top of that, he pocketed an extra $20 million, according to Rolling Stone.Bieber already secured a reported record $10 million payday from the festival itself — the highest ever for a Coachella headliner — after negotiating the deal directly without an agent. The desert set drew a massive crowd, mixed old hits with newer tracks, and sparked plenty of buzz online.Critics called parts of the show lazy, with Bieber spending time behind a laptop, but the numbers don't lie: his name still moves the needle and fills the bank account.
